en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a central square with a cobblestone street and stone balustrade in the foreground. On the left stands an equestrian statue on a high pedestal. Behind it are historic multi‑story buildings with ornate facades and tiled roofs, and a tram with carriages runs through the busy square filled with pedestrians. Tree branches frame the top of the image. The reverse side is a standard divided postcard back with Hungarian text printed in the upper left and along the vertical center.
